written_before_outcomes: written 2026-10-18 (about 19:00-20:00Z), before any fit, label read or candidate outcome of this campaign; inputs: the coordinator DESIGN_BRIEF.md, the source campaign's published rules (OHN1-rules-v1), its code (ohn/rules.py, ohn/protect.py, ihs/evaluate.py) and its published RESEARCH_DECISION.md and reader_robustness/RR_FINAL__INCOME_NOISE.json aggregates. No real data was read and no real-data computation was run.
implementation: cts/rules.py (pure numpy/scipy; load_rules() refuses a rule file whose constants disagree with the module); invented-data tests: python3 -m cts.test_rules
status_of_every_rule: development rules on previously used records; asymptotic and model-based where they use uncertainty; no rule changes a cap and none is a population or finite-sample guarantee

original_limits.utility_clause_index: 2 tasks (income, occupation) x 2 references (U0, Ucal) x 3 metrics (accuracy_loss, nll_excess, brier_excess) x 2 source seeds
original_limits.subgroup_guard_index: within-SEX occupation summed-Brier excess against U0, men (sex0, SEX code 1) and women (sex1, SEX code 2) x 2 source seeds
original_limits.target_is_separate: the 0.020 material-benefit target is reported separately from positive superiority and from every gate

metrics.definitions: unchanged from scm_bench.common.task_vectors: per person accuracy = 1[argmax p = y]; NLL = -log(max(p_y, 1e-12)); summed multiclass Brier = sum_k (p_k - 1[y = k])^2
metrics.nll_floor_disclosure: the NLL keeps the existing 1e-12 probability floor (a person whose probability for the true class is below 1e-12 contributes at most 27.63 nats); no new loss is introduced
metrics.probabilities: occupation probabilities = softmax of centred logits (acs_replication.trees.probabilities('occupation', z)); logits of a probability vector = centred log(max(p, 1e-300))
metrics.incremental_cost: corrected minus uncorrected release on the same people: men_brier and women_brier = mean summed-Brier increase within SEX group; brier = mean summed-Brier increase; nll = mean NLL increase; acc_loss = uncorrected accuracy minus corrected accuracy
metrics.standard_errors: household-clustered SE of a mean (ihs.evaluate.cluster_se: cluster sums of centred values, G/(G-1) correction); SEX-group means use the linearized household-clustered SE of a ratio of means computed on the whole set with the group mask (ihs.evaluate.subgroup_se)

conditions.per_partition: the 8 occupation-side conditions of the partition's witness on MODEL_SELECT against the references of the associated source seed (D0, R0 -> seed 0; D1, R1 -> seed 1)

reserve.rule: reserve slack rho_c = margin_c - k x se_used_c; margin_c = cap_c - value_c of the witness; se_used_c = max(own SE, floor SE)
reserve.floor: H_LJ's MODEL_SELECT SE of the same condition and seed, copied unchanged from OHN1-rules-v1 (itself copied from the income-headroom successor's RESERVE_RULE.json), rescaled by sqrt(5306 / households)
reserve.zero_or_tiny_se: own SE = 0 or below the floor: se_used = floor (> 0), recorded se_source 'floor'; a floor that is missing, non-finite or <= 0 is refused (error); a negative own SE is refused (error); a non-finite value, margin or own SE gives slack -inf (the condition admits no correction)
reserve.meaning: a development robustness objective (the frozen source reserve rule), not a guarantee; the baseline slack and the incremental cost are reported separately

ladder.definition: s_j = j / 10, j = 0..10; s = 0 is the uncorrected witness (identity), always admissible, never tested
ladder.release: r_s(x) = softmax(log p_W(x) + s x Delta_full(x)); deployed-ensemble e_s(x) = mean_k softmax(log p_Wk(x) + s x Delta_k(x))

OLD.definition: the source end projection reproduced: costs out of fold within FIT (fold pipeline k on fold k, cross-fitted witness base); budget_stat = f x min over the stat's mapped conditions of rho_c; largest s on the grid 0, 1/100, ..., 1 such that every grid point up to s is feasible, refined by 30 bisection steps toward the first infeasible grid point
OLD.implementation: re-implemented identically in cts.rules.project (same floating-point operations); the test t_old_equals_ohn_project checks bitwise equality of the chosen scale and costs with ohn.protect.project on invented arrays
OLD.known_quirk_kept: a non-positive slack gives a budget f x rho >= rho (looser than the slack); kept for exact reproduction and flagged OLD_NONPOSITIVE_SLACK

SIMPLE.definition: accept s iff for every one of the 8 conditions c: Delta_GUARD,stat(c)(s) <= b_c, with b_c = gamma x rho_c if rho_c > 0 else rho_c; ascending fixed sequence over the ladder; select the last accepted strength (identity if the first nonzero strength fails)
SIMPLE.gamma_rationale: equal to the source B50 level (the only source budget level that kept the reserve on both seeds for the PAIR arms), so OLD-B50 and SIMPLE differ only in where cost is measured (OOF within FIT vs the deployed release on GUARD) and in the strength set; a buffer of 1 - gamma = 50% of the slack absorbs transfer errors of the size the source projection made on seed 0 (30-54% of the men's slack) except its largest; not tuned to any outcome of this campaign

UNCERTAINTY.definition: accept s iff for every condition c (stat k = stat(c)) both U1 and U2 hold; ascending fixed sequence over the ladder; select the last accepted strength (identity if the first nonzero strength fails)
UNCERTAINTY.U1_transfer_to_benchmark_role: Delta_k(s) + z x tau_k(s) <= rho_c, tau_k(s) = max(SE_k(s), phi_k) x sqrt(1 + n_GUARD,k / n_MS,k)
UNCERTAINTY.U2_population_cap: Delta_k(s) + z x sqrt(max(SE_k(s), phi_k)^2 + se_used_c^2) <= margin_c (implied by U1 when z <= k; checked explicitly)
UNCERTAINTY.n_definition: people counts of the stat's population: all people for brier, nll and acc_loss; men for men_brier; women for women_brier; n_MS from the witness's MODEL_SELECT evaluation
UNCERTAINTY.se_definition: SE_k(s): household-clustered SE on GUARD (cluster_se); for men_brier / women_brier the linearized household-clustered SE within the SEX group (subgroup_se on the whole GUARD set)
UNCERTAINTY.multiplicity: intersection-union over the 8 conditions and both U1 / U2 parts (no Bonferroni); fixed-sequence over the ascending ladder (no adjustment); see RULES.md section 5
UNCERTAINTY.status: asymptotic, model-based development rule; a normal or bootstrap upper bound is not a distribution-free finite-sample certificate; no finite-sample guarantee is claimed

rules.identity: always a valid outcome; earns no protection-component claim
rules.deployments: every rule is applied to the deployed full release and, separately, to the deployed-ensemble release; the two are never mixed

diagnostics_recorded_never_gating: per strength and stat: GUARD estimate and SE; realized CHECK and MODEL_SELECT increments and SEs; OOF increment
signed transfer error = realized - predicted (positive = cost under-predicted), absolute error, error / stat slack (stat slack = min over mapped conditions of rho_c; undefined if <= 0)
constraint crossings: realized cost > rho_c (reserve crossing) and realized cost > margin_c (point-cap crossing) at a strength the rule accepted
correction magnitude: mean over people and classes of |s x centred Delta|, decision flip rate against the witness (label-free)
realized MODEL_SELECT reserve of the corrected release with its own se_used (it can differ from the witness's)

per_rule_partition: realized slack use on CHECK and on MODEL_SELECT (max over the 8 conditions of realized cost / rho_c, and per condition)
reserve crossing indicator (any realized cost > rho_c)
point-cap crossing indicator (any realized cost > margin_c)
realized protection from the reader grid (computed by the reader investigator)

prediction_comparison.question: A: improved correction-cost prediction on excluded households
prediction_comparison.errors: e_X(s, k) = Delta_CHECK,k(s) - Delta_X,k(s), X in {GUARD, OOF}, s in the 10 nonzero ladder strengths, k in the 5 stats
prediction_comparison.score: MAE_rel(X) = mean over (s, k) with stat slack > 0 of |e_X(s, k)| / stat slack_k
prediction_comparison.uncertainty: paired household bootstrap, conditional on the fitted pipelines: households resampled independently within FIT (OOF people), GUARD and CHECK; B replicates; D recomputed on each
prediction_comparison.label_rule: PREDICTION_IMPROVED on a partition iff D > 0 and the 5% bootstrap quantile of D > 0; also reported: sign count of |e_GUARD| < |e_OOF| over the 50 (s, k) cells, mean signed errors (bias) per stat
prediction_comparison.language: descriptive across partitions (only 2 diagnostic and 2 repair partitions, overlapping training sets): 'on both diagnostic partitions', never a population rate

rungs: 6 JOINT_DESIGN_ADVANTAGE: NOT_CLAIMABLE (Track F optimizes occupation only: coalition-aware occupation correction); NOVELTY: NOT_CLAIMED (assessed separately)
claim_ladder.order: rungs 1-5 are evaluated in order; a rung is claimable only if every lower rung holds; higher rungs are still computed and reported descriptively with NOT_CLAIMABLE_LOWER_RUNG_UNMET

recipe_selection.recipe: (routing, direction arm, deployment, rule); arms PAIR or LOC (CONT is a control, never a recipe)
recipe_selection.when: after the D0 / D1 diagnosis and before any repair CHECK panel (C0, C1) label is opened (before REPAIR_FREEZE)
gates_on_both_D_partitions: G2 no realized reserve crossing on D CHECK and on MODEL_SELECT at the selected strength
G3 complete release (H3 income) passes all 12 utility clauses and 2 guards of the associated seed at the point on MODEL_SELECT
G4 a development reader-grid entry against the matched CONT control exists
recipe_selection.score: min over the two D partitions of (d_P - 2 x sd_total) of the pair benefit against the matched CONT control (source stability spread over the partition's 4 cells)
tie_breaks: larger minimum realized MODEL_SELECT reserve ratio (rho_c - realized cost_c) / se_used_c over both D partitions and 8 conditions (leximin)
rule order SIMPLE, UNCERTAINTY, OLD-B50, OLD-B80
recipe_selection.no_switch: every frozen rule is still evaluated on the repair CHECK panels; the selected recipe is never switched to the winner there

screens.old_per_cell_gate: every one of the 8 registered cells: candidate single-output SCORE AUC minus comparator's <= +0.010 (inclusive), income and occupation views, every required comparator

aggregate_paired_rule.name: AGG1
aggregate_paired_rule.estimate: dbar = mean of the cells (both seeds, all repetitions and reader seeds)
aggregate_paired_rule.repetition_means: y_R = mean over seeds and reader seeds of the cells of repetition R; se_R = mean over the same cells of the bootstrap SEs
aggregate_paired_rule.upper_bound: U = dbar + z x sqrt(phi x v_samp)
aggregate_paired_rule.pass: U <= 0.010 for this (candidate, comparator, view); the configuration passes the screen iff every required comparator and both views pass (intersection-union)
aggregate_paired_rule.exact_alias: candidate view wire bitwise equal to the comparator's on both seeds: the difference is exactly 0 by construction; label EXACT_ALIAS, pass; an alias whose cached cells are not all 0 is an error
aggregate_paired_rule.phi_prior_formula: GROSS construction, one for all three views: phi_prior(view) = [mean over the distinct-wire pairs of the frozen source grid of sd_split_gross^2] / [mean over the same pairs of rms_cell_se^2], sd_split_gross^2 = mean over seeds of (x_{s,R1} - x_{s,R2})^2 / 2, x_{s,R} = mean over reader seeds of the cells of seed s and repetition R (so it INCLUDES the reader-seed share var_k / 2). Rationale: AGG1's variance is that of a mean of repetition means which contain reader-seed noise, and phi_emp is computed on that same gross scale. Equivalently sd_split_gross^2 = sd_split_net^2 + var_k / 2; the source's rr_analysis.income_noise reported the NET value (income: net sd_split 0.02123682861190588, reader-seed SD 0.0018486366498115536, rms_cell_se 0.008962013990683278 -> gross phi 5.636511599640259).
recorded_never_gating: per-seed upper bounds U_s = dbar_s + z x sqrt(phi x sum_R se_{s,R}^2 / n_R^2) and flag AGG_SEED_EDGE when some U_s > 0.010
aggregate_paired_rule.meaning: a pass is permission for further development, not evidence of protection; the old gate is always reported beside it; the source campaign's labels are never rewritten
aggregate_paired_rule.phi_prior_provenance: computed label-free by the reader investigator from the frozen source grid (13 banks, GRID.json + BOOT.npz) before any new outcome; relayed by the coordinator 2026-10-18 about 19:05Z; wire groups / pairs: income 9 / 36, occupation 19 / 171, pair 26 / 325

phi_prior_net_not_used.note: net construction (reader-seed share removed); recorded for transparency only; not used

aggregate_paired_rule.effective_floor_note: with phi = max(1, phi_prior, phi_emp) the prior binds above 1 only for the income view (5.637) and the pair view (1.087); for the occupation view the floor 1 binds

screens.operating_characteristics: RULES.md section 10 (laws L0a, L0b, L1, L2); simulated rejection rates under those laws only

reserve_qualified_frontier.reserve: the source whole-release reserve (all 28 conditions, k = 2, H_LJ floor) applied identically to candidates and every reference
reserve_qualified_frontier.historical_references: every original point-eligible reference is shown with its reserve status (from the source: SUCC, H_LJ, B2TWIN, TWJ min ratios 0.321 / 0.624; RETIRED_B3CTL 0.321 / 0.349; NEURAL_RAW 1.947 / 1.558: all fail)
reserve_qualified_frontier.statement: a positive reserve-qualified result is not superiority over every original reference

matched_controls: CONT (critic weight zero, same pipeline and rule)
COMP (label-free compression code at matched realized cost)
